text:
Marta L: prod alert — three inference pods (redwood-runtime-1-3/5/7) OOM'd serving long-context synthetic workload after merge 2f3a9c. Root cause looks like KV cache growth.
Devon H: ack. which PR is 2f3a9c? iirc that was the kernel-router preference change.
Marta L: correct — PR #4021. Started ~03:12 UTC. We tried a soft rollback but kube rollout stuck on terminating pods. logs show steady kv cache growth up to node OOM.
CI-Bot: perf-ci/regression: longctx-kv test +18% memory for kv-cache vs baseline on commit 2f3a9c. Full results: https://ci.internal/redwood/205000/reports/longctx
Devon H: starting local repro now.
Devon H: repro command I used:
```
./tests/repro_longctx --model redwood-7b --seq 8192 --batch 4 --concurrency 6
```
Repro hits OOM ~2m in. dmesg shows kernel killed process due to anon memory growth.
Marta L: pasted excerpt from pod log:
```
[2025-05-12T03:18:21Z] kv_cache_bytes=12.3G
[2025-05-12T03:20:44Z] kv_cache_bytes=18.7G
malloc failed: cannot allocate 67108864 bytes
OOM killer invoked for pid 23456
```
Anya P: ran a heap profile on the repro, hot path points to kernel_dispatch -> kernel_x::alloc_kv_batch. Looks like kernel_x keeps per-batch metadata that grows with seq length. snippet:
```
heap profile top:
 65% kernel_x::alloc_kv_batch
 12% kv::store_entry
 8% slices::copy_aligned
```
Anya P: hypothesis — router change prefers kernel_x for certain model shapes; kernel_x has an allocation pattern that's unbounded for long seqs (alignment + per-token bookkeeping).
Kevin S: ops notes — affected nodes had swap disabled and no extra oom logging. not helping. we can enable oom logs but that's after the fact.
Devon H: quick mitigant: forced ROUTER_OVERRIDE to legacy-kernel for the longctx model; memory dropped to ~8.9G and repro completed. So this is a kernel-selection regression, not a general kv bug.
Marta L: ok — I'll open rollback PR now and pause rollout. PR #4030 created to revert the kernel-router preference change. tagging eng-runtime on-call.
Devon H: i'll add a unit test to kernel-selector that exercises seq=8192 and asserts chosen kernel and kv bytes within threshold. also adding a perf-ci longctx job (seq 8192, concurrency 6) to catch regression.
Anya P: i'll add a kv-cache metric (runtime.kv_cache_bytes_per_model) and a regression alert if >+10% vs baseline for longctx tests.
Kevin S: ops will schedule a short rollback window and add OOM logging + a node-level guard (reject requests with seq > 4096 on canary until we have a fix).
Marta L: plan sounds good. action items:
- Marta: coordinate rollback PR #4030 and pause rollout (in progress)
- Devon: kernel-selector unit test + repro automation (GH issue assigned)
- Anya: perf-ci longctx job + kv metric and alert
- Kevin: rollback window + enable oom logging
We'll post a short postmortem after initial triage. Thanks — tagging @devon and @anya for follow-ups. :eyes:
